Add applyMergePatch implementing JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386)

Export applyMergePatch(target, patch) from src/index.ts. Members whose patch
value is null are removed, object members merge recursively, and arrays and
non-object patches replace the target. Inputs are not mutated and are checked
to be JSON values.
